GLDDF.Dialog.FatedRollHint: Throw the fate die once this check lands. A complication adds its number to the result.
GLDDF.Settings.Preset.Name: Terminology Preset
GLDDF.Settings.Preset.Hint: The words and tones for each result, on the die and in chat. Default says Opportunity and Complication, Aegis Fallen says Defiance and Tyranny, Tides of Destiny says Tide and Storm. The odds do not change. Requires a reload.
GLDDF.Settings.EmissiveIntensity.Name: Die Glow
GLDDF.Settings.EmissiveIntensity.Hint: How brightly the glyphs on the 3D fate die glow in Dice So Nice. 0 turns the glow off, which also spares the dice tray its bloom pass for the throw; the glyphs stay painted on. Requires a reload.
GLDDF.Settings.MotionTier.Name: Animation Style
GLDDF.Settings.MotionTier.Hint: How the fate strip arrives in chat on your screen. Reduced is a short fade, Default lands the die and the result, Cinematic takes its time.
GLDDF.Settings.FaceConfig.Name: Dice Faces
GLDDF.Settings.FaceConfig.Label: Configure
GLDDF.Settings.FaceConfig.Hint: What each of the six faces is, and the number a complication adds.
GLDDF.Settings.FaceConfig.Title: Fate Die Faces
GLDDF.Settings.FaceConfig.ReloadHint: The 3D die is drawn from this table when Dice So Nice starts, so saving a change asks to reload. Chat results use it right away.
GLDDF.Config.Intro: Six faces, thrown with a check. An opportunity adds nothing to the number; a complication or a blank adds what you set here.
GLDDF.Notify.NoFace: Destiny Dice | {notation} produced no readable face. See the console for details.
GLDDF.Notify.RollFailed: Destiny Dice | The fate die could not be thrown. See the console for details.
